en: the grassy edge of an original floating island high above the clouds: a level meadow of short grass and wildflowers with a worn earth path, the ground ending in a rocky cliff edge across the far side beyond which a sea of white clouds stretches to the horizon, two other smaller floating islands with trees and hanging roots drifting in the far distance on the left and right, a weathered stone arch ruin at the left edge, a gnarled windswept tree at the right edge, and an empty patch of grass in the centre about four metres from the camera, well back from the cliff
light: Bright clear day, high sun, deep blue sky, crisp shadows on the grass, the cloud sea brilliant white

en: an original xianxia mountain terrace high above a sea of clouds: a wide flat platform of pale white jade-like stone slabs with a carved white stone balustrade along the far edge, beyond it a vast sea of rolling clouds with sharp green-cloaked karst peaks rising out of it into the distance, a pavilion of red timber with sweeping upturned eaves and grey glazed tiles standing on a rock outcrop at the left edge, a twisted old pine growing from the cliff at the right edge, a long waterfall falling from a distant peak into the clouds, and an empty stretch of stone terrace in the centre about four metres from the camera
light: Sunrise, the sun just above the cloud sea on the right, the clouds lit gold and rose, cool blue shadows on the terrace

en: the courtyard of an original wuxia-style country inn in a bamboo forest: a two-storey timber inn building with a covered upper gallery, wooden lattice doors and a grey tile roof across the far side, a blank wooden signboard over the door and a blank cloth banner on a tall bamboo pole at the left edge, a low wooden fence and dense tall green bamboo grove closing the left and right, a stone well and stacked wine jars with plain red paper seals at the right edge, a packed earth yard, and an empty patch of earth in the centre about four metres from the camera
light: Soft green-filtered daylight through the bamboo, light mist among the stalks

en: a large photographic studio white cyclorama, a smooth matte white curved wall that sweeps seamlessly into a matte white floor with no visible corner or seam, the white surface filling the whole background and both edges of the frame, the floor-to-wall curve forming a soft gradient band far behind the standing spot, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of plain white floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
ja: 白ホリゾント（ハイキー）
light: Bright even high-key studio light, the white backdrop clean and nearly shadowless, a very faint soft shadow area on the floor at the centre, not blown out

en: a photographic studio set of a wide roll of neutral mid-grey seamless backdrop paper hanging from far above the frame and sweeping in a smooth curve onto the floor toward the camera, the neutral mid-grey paper filling the whole background and both edges of the frame with a uniform matte surface, no creases or tears, the same paper continuing under the standing spot, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of plain neutral mid-grey paper floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
ja: 背景紙（ミディアムグレー）
light: Soft even studio light from the front, a gentle darker falloff toward the top of the backdrop

en: a photographic studio set of matte black seamless backdrop paper sweeping in a smooth curve from the background onto the floor, the black filling the whole background and both edges of the frame and fading to pure black toward the top and sides, the matte black floor faintly visible in front, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of matte black floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
light: Low-key studio light, a soft pool of light on the black floor at the centre, everything else falling off into deep black, no light source in frame

ti: 手绘肌理布（古典肖像光）
zh: 手绘肌理布（古典肖像光）
en: a photographic studio set of a large hand-painted canvas backdrop with a soft mottled cloudy pattern in muted olive grey and brown tones, darker at the edges and lighter behind the centre, the canvas filling the whole background and both edges of the frame and draping in a smooth sweep onto the floor toward the camera, no visible hem, frame or pattern of recognisable shapes, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of plain canvas floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
ja: 手描き背景布（クラシック）
light: Soft directional light from the upper left like a classic portrait studio, gentle shadows in the canvas folds

en: a daylight photo studio with a plain warm white plaster far wall filling the background, a tall floor-to-ceiling window along the left wall covered by sheer white curtains that hang straight and let light through but show no view outside, a pale bleached wood floor running from the window to the right edge, the right side plain white wall, no furniture, no plants, no equipment, and a clear patch of plain wood floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
ja: 窓明かりのスタジオ（朝の光）
light: Soft morning daylight diffused through the sheer curtains from the left, a gentle light-to-shadow gradient across the room from left to right

ti: 彩色滤光影棚（品红与青）
zh: 彩色滤光影棚（品红与青）
en: a photographic studio set of light grey seamless backdrop paper sweeping in a smooth curve onto the floor, the backdrop filling the whole background and both edges of the frame, washed with coloured light so the left half of the backdrop glows magenta and the right half glows teal, the two colours blending softly in a vertical band behind the standing spot, the floor picking up both colours, no lamps or stands visible, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of grey seamless floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
ja: カラーゲルのスタジオ（マゼンタ×ティール）
light: Saturated coloured gel light from out of frame, magenta from the left and teal from the right, a moody contrasty look with the backdrop clearly showing both hues
